# iHeart

> > iHeart is a comprehensive music streaming platform featuring artist profiles, discographies, and radio stations across all genres from pop icons like Taylor Swift and Post Malone to international and devotional music.

The platform provides extensive artist biographies, top songs, albums, and personalized radio stations. iHeart covers diverse musical traditions including Western pop, reggae, classical, devotional music from India and the Middle East, and regional genres worldwide.
